body.statement: Every finite first-order formula over a real closed field that is built from polynomial equalities and inequalities admits an algorithmically computable equivalent quantifier-free formula; in particular, existential projections of finite semialgebraic sets are semialgebraic and quantifier elimination terminates.

source.locator: Chapter 2, Theorem 2.77, and Chapter 16 on effective quantifier elimination
source.verbatim_statement: The theory of real closed fields admits quantifier elimination in the language of ordered fields.

attestation.note: Verified from the lawful searchable Google Books publisher preview of Basu–Pollack–Roy, page 69, Theorem 2.77; page 70 states the resulting quantifier-free formula has polynomial equations and inequalities, and the same edition provides effective algorithms.
